top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards targeted protein degradation as a new, quantitatively measurable design principle (ternary-complex cooperativity, linker dependence, VHL ligand structures) that is reproduced across many laboratories and makes pocketless targets addressable. Crews and Deshaies hold the concept; Ciulli's structure-guided VHL ligands and ternary-complex work made it rational design. The citation about hijacking the ubiquitin-proteasome system is accurate without over-crediting. P003 is the same achievement with Handa in place of Ciulli, which I rank second because cereblon explains why an existing drug works rather than giving a general design rule. P002 (Buchwald and Hartwig, C-N coupling) is mature and well attributed but largely an extension of the 2010 cross-coupling prize, and I rank it above no award because it is a real, verifiable achievement.
